---
title: "Generate Access Token"
api: "POST /auth/token"
description: "Generate an access token for external API authentication using Basic Authentication"
---

Generate an access token for external API authentication. This endpoint uses Basic Authentication and is designed for third-party integrations and external applications.

<Note>
  **External API Endpoint**
  
  This endpoint is part of the External API category and uses Basic Authentication. It's designed for third-party integrations and external services.
</Note>

## Authentication

This endpoint requires Basic Authentication. Include your username and password in the Authorization header:

<CodeBlock lang="bash">
{`Authorization: Basic <base64_encoded_credentials>`}
</CodeBlock>

## Request

No request body required for this endpoint.

## Response

<ResponseField name="success" type="boolean">
  Indicates if the request was successful
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data" type="object">
  Contains the access token information
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.access_token" type="string">
  The JWT access token for API authentication
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.token_type" type="string">
  The token type, always "Bearer"
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.expires_in" type="integer">
  Token expiration time in seconds (typically 3600 seconds = 1 hour)
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="message" type="string">
  Human-readable message about the operation result
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="timestamp" type="string">
  ISO 8601 timestamp of the response
</ResponseField>

## Example Request

<CodeGroup>
```bash cURL
curl -X POST "https://external.example.com/auth/token" \
  -H "Authorization: Basic $(echo -n 'username:password' | base64)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript JavaScript
const credentials = btoa('username:password');
const response = await fetch('https://external.example.com/auth/token', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Basic ${credentials}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  }
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```python Python
import base64
import requests

credentials = base64.b64encode(b'username:password').decode('ascii')
response = requests.post(
    'https://external.example.com/auth/token',
    headers={
        'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    }
)

print(response.json())
```

```php PHP
<?php
$credentials = base64_encode('username:password');
$response = file_get_contents('https://external.example.com/auth/token', false, stream_context_create([
    'http' => [
        'method' => 'POST',
        'header' => [
            'Authorization: Basic ' . $credentials,
            'Content-Type: application/json'
        ]
    ]
]));

$data = json_decode($response, true);
print_r($data);
?>
```

```go Go
package main

import (
    "bytes"
    "encoding/base64"
    "fmt"
    "net/http"
)

func main() {
    credentials := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte("username:password"))
    
    req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://external.example.com/auth/token", nil)
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Basic "+credentials)
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    
    client := &http.Client{}
    resp, _ := client.Do(req)
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    
    // Process response
    fmt.Println("Access token generated")
}
```
</CodeGroup>

## Usage Notes

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Token Usage" icon="key">
    The generated access token should be used in the `Authorization` header for subsequent API calls:
    
    ```
    Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
    ```
  </Accordion>
  
  <Accordion title="Token Expiration" icon="clock">
    Access tokens expire after 1 hour (3600 seconds). You'll need to generate a new token when it expires.
  </Accordion>
  
  <Accordion title="Security Best Practices" icon="shield">
    - Always use HTTPS when making requests
    - Store credentials securely (environment variables, not in code)
    - Rotate credentials regularly
    - Never log or expose access tokens
  </Accordion>
  
  <Accordion title="Rate Limiting" icon="clock">
    This endpoint is subject to rate limiting. Check response headers for rate limit information:
    - `X-RateLimit-Limit`: Maximum requests per hour
    - `X-RateLimit-Remaining`: Remaining requests in current window
    - `X-RateLimit-Reset`: Time when rate limit resets
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
